section.catchline: Tax credit for cash contributions to sheltered workshops.
section.subsection: For tax years beginning January 1, 1983, and thereafter, in computing the tax due the state under Section 59-10-104 there shall be a nonrefundable tax credit allowed for cash contributions made by a claimant, estate, or trust within the taxable year to nonprofit rehabilitation sheltered workshop facilities for persons with a disability operating in Utah that are certified by the Department of Health and Human Services as a qualifying facility.
The allowable tax credit is an amount equal to 50% of the aggregate amount of the cash contributions to the qualifying rehabilitation facilities, but the allowed tax credit may not exceed $200.
The amount of contribution claimed as a tax credit under this section may not also be claimed as a charitable deduction in determining net taxable income.
